author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this 30th anniversary celebration trailer for Dead or Alive. The fan-favourite 3D fighter takes a look back at its 30 year history, from it's humble beginnings in 1996, to the modern day with Dead or Alive 6 Ultimate, follow the series from its quarter chomping arcade days, all the way to modern consoles! 

Stick around to the end for a quick teaser for the next Dead or Alive game, with a jaw-dropping new character model for Kasumi! Dead or Alive 7 is in development now!
title: Dead or Alive - Official 30th Anniversary Trailer (ft. Dead or Alive 7 Teaser)

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest teaser trailer for Ghost Justice, an upcoming tactical strategy game. Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat. Ghost Justice will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Ghost Justice - Official Atmospheric Teaser Trailer
